headline: Centrum Capital allots 1.16 crore equity shares on warrant conversion
summary: Centrum Capital Limited has announced the allotment of 11,687,704 equity shares following the exercise of warrants by investors. This allotment increases the company's total paid-up equity base. Existing shareholders will experience equity dilution as a result of the new share creation. Retail investors tracking financial services companies should note changes in capital structure.
why_it_matters: Equity dilution affects your per-share value in Centrum Capital
